# Carbone

Carbone is a fast and simple report generator that converts JSON data into various document formats such as PDF, DOCX, XLSX, ODT, and more, using templates.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/carbone/.

## Actions

- **Delete Carbone Template**: Delete a template from the carbone server.
- **Download Template** (read-only): Download a template from carbone by template id.
- **Generate Carbone Report**: Generate a carbone report from a template and json data.
- **Generate Template ID**: Generate a unique template id for a new template.
- **Get Carbone Server Status** (read-only): Retrieve the current status and health of the carbone server.
- **Upload a template**: Upload a template to the carbone server.
- **Set Carbone API Version**: Set the carbone api version to be used for subsequent requests.
